statement: Received certificate for implementing EMS in accordance with ISO 14001:2015

To be a globally respected and dependable manufacturer of stainless-steel pipes and tubes, recognized not only for quality and trust, but also for fostering innovation and growth that is in harmony with the environment.
The Company invests in renewable energy and resource-efﬁcient practices across its facilities.
The Environment (Protection) Act, 1986, as amended (“EPA”) and the Environment (Protection) Rules, 1986 are applicable to the Company.
The Environmental Impact Assessment Notification, 2006 is applicable to the Company.
The Air (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, 1981, as amended and in force from time to time (“Air Act”) is applicable to the Company.
The Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, 1974, as amended (“Water Act”) is applicable to the Company.
The Hazardous and Other Wastes (Management and Trans boundary Movement) Rules, 2016, (“Hazardous Wastes Rules”) are applicable to the Company.
